text:
Jordan (AE): Quick Q for @Priya and @Anika — AcmeCorp legal asked for an attestation letter + SOC 2 artifacts for a short POC. They also want staging IP allowlist and to know if we can do customer-managed keys for the POC. Any blockers on providing a signed pen-test attestation?

Priya (Solutions): We can share the SOC 2 summary + a control mapping export under NDA. For the pen-test attestation we have a standard attestation template (signed by Legal) — need customer name + contact and scope. What ETA do they want? :calendar:

Anika (Security): We typically provide a high-level pen-test attestation (eg "external penetration test completed on YYYY-MM-DD; no critical findings") rather than full report. Legal needs the exact customer name on the letter. If they want staging included in scope, confirm the staging CIDRs. Also flag: if PII/PHI is in scope that changes wording.

Luca (Eng): For staging allowlist we'll need the exact CIDRs or IPs. If they want KMS separation: hosted customers cannot bring their own CMK; Dedicated or Private supports customer-managed keys. If the ask is single-tenant key isolation for the POC, that's Private or a Dedicated + KMS config — there are infra lead times.

Jordan (AE): They said "staging" only and will provide CIDRs. Procurement also asked whether Dedicated is required for CMK and what the pricing delta is for a short-term POC (1 month). Any quick guidance on ballpark?

Priya (Solutions): Short answer: yes — CMK for tenant-level separation implies Dedicated/Private. Ballpark: Dedicated entry tier (reserved capacity) + KMS integration add ~ $10k–$25k/month depending on GPU footprint and SLA. I'll pull a more precise range and DM finance.

Anika (Security): To proceed I need: 1) customer legal name for the attestation, 2) list of staging IPs/CIDRs, 3) confirmation whether any regulated data (PHI/PCI) will be used in POC. Once we have those, Legal + Security can turn around the signed attestation (usually 3–5 business days).

Jordan (AE): Great — I'll ask them for the CIDRs and whether PHI is involved. Also asking procurement for how flexible they are on Dedicated commitment.

DeployBot: New presales ticket created: https://redwood.example.com/presales/28741 — includes SOC2 summary link and attestation template.

Priya (Solutions): +1 on timeline. I'll prepare the SOC 2 artifact bundle (redacted) and the legal attestation template to speed sign-off. :thumbsup:

Jordan (AE): Thanks team — I'll post whatever they send here.
